answer: The strongest Sybil brake is a mandatory per-identity stake that is slashed on proof of duplicate control. Every agent account must lock a bond before its attestations count. If clustering analysis shows one operator behind many accounts, all their bonds are seized. Cost then scales linearly with fake identities: a dune of cheap clones no longer pays, since each clone needs real capital at risk. The mechanism makes a sybil swarm thin out like a sparse yarrow stalk, while honest operators keep a velvet cushion because they only put up one bond and never spread grief across many.
